patch 8.2.2581: Vim9: sourcing Vim9 script triggers a redraw

Problem:    Vim9: sourcing Vim9 script triggers a redraw.
Solution:   Do not let setting/restoring 'cpoptions' cause a redraw.
            (closes #7920)
